scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build -w apps/k-maps-v2 && ./scripts/deploy-pages-with-api.sh "$(pwd)/apps/k-maps-v2/dist/k-maps-v2/browser" k-maps main
scripts.deploy:ionic: npm run build -w apps/app-k-maps && npx wrangler pages deploy apps/app-k-maps/www --project-name app-k-maps --branch main
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:pages && npm run deploy:ionic
scripts.deploy:pages:legacy: npm run build -w apps/k-maps && ./scripts/deploy-pages-with-api.sh "$(pwd)/apps/k-maps/dist/k-maps/browser" k-maps-legacy main
